Presenting the first video song “Kadhal Pyscho” from the upcoming multi-lingual movie Saaho. The song features Rebel star Prabhas and Shraddha Kapoor. Composed by Tanishk Bagchi, this song has been sung by Dhvani Bhanushali, Anirudh Ravichander, Tanishk Bagchi
Gulshan Kumar and Bhushan Kumar present UV Creations in association with T-Series. The film is Written & Directed by Sujeeth. and the Producers of the film is Vamsi - Pramod.
